messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-3.4.0 is released and on Pypi.
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] rpy2-3.4.0 is released and on Pypi.
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.4.0 is released and on Pypi. In addition to the source package
binary wheels for MacOS (Python versions 3.7 and 3.8) are also made
available.

If using R-4.0 or greater and updated is recommended, and may be even
necessary.

The full changelog is in here:
https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v3.4.x/html/changes.html#release-3-4-0


Best,


Laurent

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.4.2 is released. This is a bugfix release mostly addressing an issue
with multithreading.
The changelog is here:
https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v3.4.x/html/changes.html#release-3-4-2

Best,

Laurent
